policy_contract.all_tables: RLS enabled and at least one policy, including private ingestion tables
policy_contract.knowledge_default: authenticated has SELECT only; anon has no table or column privileges
policy_contract.private_ingestion: Exact table comment opts into server-only access. No anon/authenticated privileges; no PUBLIC/anon/authenticated/service_role policies. At least one policy role must have a write grant. This is no exception to RLS.
policy_contract.sql_tests: 00 lists baseline names explicitly because pg_prove runs inside Postgres and cannot read a checkout JSON file. Keep that list aligned when an integrator approves a future baseline. 05/14 inspect live catalogs.

static_scope_limits: Fail closed for unsupported SQL, unqualified targets, DO, procedural/dynamic function bodies, search_path changes and extension DDL (IF NOT EXISTS cannot prove a no-op without live catalog state).
Only inspected read-only SQL function bodies with reviewed builtins are accepted. Qualified calls remain subject to schema ownership and runtime pgTAP checks.
This tokenizer cannot prove function semantics, policy authorization, runtime privileges or dependency behavior. Integration pgTAP and both migration orders are mandatory.
